Stock market news | NSE 35% Share Rally After RBI Nod

NSE shares rallied 35% in a month and the RBI gave clearance for corporate bond index futures after SEBI approval in October.

The regulatory approval expands trading instruments on the exchange, potentially attracting more market participants.
